Commentary.Commentary: Ireland on the other hand, will love a wicket here. Can they pick one? We will have to wait to find out.
Now then, England have just the one over to play out. It will be 6 nervy balls. They need to come out unscathed.

England were excellent in this session. They got their lengths right, got the ball to do a little. Especially Broad and Olly Stone. The two finished with 3 each. Curran took one and Moeen Ali got the last one.

A session which England will be mighty pleased with! They have managed to crawl back in the game. Ireland is still ahead but they would surely not be pleased with how they batted in this session. They were just two down when they entered this session but then lost wickets at regular intervals. After Stirling and Balbirnie fell, the middle order failed to contribute a lot. At once, it seemed the lead would not cross 100 but a gritty knock from Kevin O'Brien and contributions from the lower order saw them extend their lead to 122.
OUT! Bowled! Right through him. Floated ball on middle, Rankin goes for a big heave but misses. The ball goes onto hit the middle pole. Ireland bowled out for 207 and lead England by 122 runs.
Loopy ball outside off, Rankin strokes it back to the bowler.

FOUR BYES! Olly tries to bowl a bouncer but it is way too high and wide down the leg side. O'Brien tries to hook and misses, Jonny Bairstow tries to dive high to his left and get a hand to it but fails. The ball rolls to the fine leg fence for four byes.
Short ball around the body, O'Brien does well to keep it down and away from short leg.
Down the leg side by Stone, O'Brien tries to get bat on it but misses. Bairstow does well to dive low down to his left and collect it.
Back of a length ball on off, O'Brien hops and does well to keep it down.
Short of a length ball this time, O'Brien pushes it to cover point.
Close! Good length ball on off, it comes back in sharply. Kevin O'Brien looks to flick and luckily gets an inside edge onto his pads.
EDGED and FOUR! Good ball from Broad but Rankin gets an outside edge which goes past the point fielder and into the third man fence.
Good length delivery on off stump, Kevin flicks it away towards deep square leg for another run.
Good length ball on middle stump, Rankin gets an inside edge while defending it and goes to the fine leg fielder for a single.
Banged in short from Broad, Boyd ducks under it and the ball goes back to the keeper.
Full delivery on off stump, Rankin drives it between the cover and mid off fielder for a couple.
Good length ball outside off stump, Rankin lets it go back to the keeper.

NOT OUT! Off the body and England lose a review. This is short and angled into the batter. Kevin O'Brien looks to pull butis beaten by pace. It lobs off something back towards the bowler who takes it with a dive to his right. An appeal follows but the umpire shakes his head. England review and replays show that there is no bat involved.
Is that off the glove? England feel so but the umpire feels different. England review.
Length ball wide outside off, O'Brien stretches and tries to connect with it but misses horribly. It looks like with the last man in, he is looking to get a move on.
Olly bowls another bouncer to follow-up the wicket ball. It is on middle and leg, O'Brien ducks under it.
Boyd Rankin is the last man in.

OUT! End of the entertainment as Murtagh holes out. Tim makes room again and Olly Stone follows him with a short one. Murtagh still goes for the pull but mistimes it towards deep mid-wicket where Burns takes it falling forward. Ireland lead by 110, they have just the one wicket in hand.

FOUR! Smashed! It seems like Murtagh can do it all. Olly pitches the ball short of a length outside off, Murtagh rocks onto the back foot and smashes this ball over mid off for a boundary. Ireland move to 5 runs short of 200 with this shot.
This is outside off, Kevin guides it down to third man and takes a single.
Fuller and on middle, Tim hits it to mid on. End of a very good over for Ireland.
FOUR! Third boundary in the over. Broad is just not learning. He bowls another short one on middle, Murtagh drags this through mid-wicket and it races away to the fence. Third boundary in the over.
FOUR! The lead is above 100 now! Murtagh is scoring some handy runs here. This is on a length again, Murtagh swats it through mid-wicket and bags the second boundary of the over.
Swing and a miss! This is slightly outside off, Tim plays like he has been, makes room and swings but misses.
Once again makes room, Broad bowls it on a length and around off, Murtagh drags it to mid on.
FOUR! That has been nailed! Murtagh once again makes room and Broad bowls it short and on the body. Tim swings, it hits the middle and races to the mid-wicket fence.
Bouncer! It is on the leg side, O'Brien sits under it.

The ball stays low! Olly bowls a length ball outside off, O'Brien expects the ball to rise up and come near the chest height as usual. Instead it stays low and goes below the bat of O'Brien as he tries to duck and play at it. Luckily for Ireland no harm done.
Shortish ball this time on the off stump line. O'Brien gets on top of it and plays it into the ground.
Full ball on off by Olly, O'Brien gets onto the front foot and pushes the ball through the cover gap where the batters run and take a couple of runs.
Outside off, Kevin leaves it alone.
On the pads, Kevin looks to flick but it goes fine down the leg side off his thigh pad. They take two leg byes.
Olly Stone is back!
Good length delivery on middle stump, Murtagh makes room again to hit it on the off side but misses it completely.
Good length delivery on off stump, Murtagh makes room and tries to slash it hard to the off side but can only edge it towards second slip.
Tim Murtagh is the new man in.

OUT! Chopped on! Broad comes around the wicket and bowls it with pace around off. The ball comes in with the angle. McBrine looks to defend but he is late on it as he gets an inside edge onto the stumps. England two wickets away from bowling out Ireland.
Back of a length ball on the body, O'Brien glances it down the leg side for a single.
Another short ball. This is on the leg side though.
The physio is out to have a check on Kevin O'Brien who is in pain here.
Nasty! Short on the body, O'Brien is late to react and the ball hits him on his ribs.
On the stumps, McBrine sees through the over with a front foot defense.
Shorter on off, McBrine cuts it late to point.
Tossed up ball on off, McBrine gets the inside edge. The ball goes down onto the pitch and towards the silly point fielder.
On the pads, defended away by McBrine.
Flighted on the leg stump line, Andy plays it to mid on.
Tossed up on middle, played to the cover fielder by Andy.
Moeen Ali is back on. Has bowled 3 overs so far.
Short ball above leg stump, Kevin does not feel the need to play at and ducks under it to let it go back to the keeper.
Short ball on the body, McBrine rocks back and plays it past the square leg fielder for a single.
Good length ball outside off stump, McBrine leaves it alone.
In the air... but safe! A good bumper. Kevin O'Brien takes on the challenge of pulling it. It goes off the top edge but safe down to fine leg for one.
FOUR! In the air but safe. Fuller delivery from Broad outside off stump. O'Brien goes for and expansive drive but it goes off the outside edge past the third man fielder for a boundary.
Excellent delivery from Broad, good length delivery on off stump, Kevin pushes at it but misses the ball by a whisker.
Stuart Broad is back into the attack!
A muted appeal but not given! Curran bowls this one on the middle stump line. It hits the thigh pad of McBrine, the English players appeal but it is clearly going over as the umpire suggests.
WIDE! Bouncer but way over and down the leg side by Curran. McBrine tries to hook but misses.
Shortish, does not bounce a lot though. McBrine looks to pull but misses to get hit near the box.
Fullish ball outside off to McBrine, he softly guides it to point.
Curran bowls this one fuller and outside off, O'Brien goes for the drive but gets the bottom edge onto the ball. The ball goes to the empty point region where they are able to take a single.
Length ball near the chest height, Kevin does well to push it down onto the ground. No runs taken.
Full length ball angling into the stumps, O'Brien gets the inside half of his bat on the ball. It hits the pads and rolls towards covers.
Down the leg side this time, McBrine lets it be.
FOUR! EDGED. Banged in short by Woakes which takes the top edge of McBrine's bat and flies over Bairstow's head for a boundary. It is McBrine's first boundary of the innings.
Good length ball on off stump, McBrine blocks it back to the bowler.
Leg bye! Fuller delivery on leg stump, Kevin tries to flick it but gets hit on the pads for a single
Short ball outside off stump, O'Brien ducks under it and lets it go.
Good length delivery on middle stump, O'Brien defends it back to the bowler.
Full on off, McBrine drives it to mid off.
Fullish ball way outside off by Curran, there to be driven. McBrine is not interested and lets it go to the keeper.
Good length ball on off, McBrine drives it to cover.
Length ball outside off by Curran, McBrine shoulders arms to this one.
Outside off, McBrine looks to defend inside the line but the ball is outside off.
WIDE! Curran is guily of bowling it way outside off. It is outside the tramline and it has been wided.
Full ball just outside off, played to cover point by O'Brien.
On the pads, McBrine leaves it. It hits him high on the thigh pad and rolls on the leg side.
FOUR! Nicely played! This is just outside off and on a length. The batter waits for it and then guides it down to the third man fence.
On off, kept out.
Swing and a miss! A loose stroke that. This is bowled way too wide outside off, McBrine throws his bat at it but misses.
Beauty! This is a lovely nut. It is on off and it is angling away. McBrine looks to defend but is beaten by the away swing.
This is on the pads, Kevin looks to flick but misses. The ball goes off the pads towards fine leg for one.
Short ball outside off, McBrine defends it back to the bowler.
Yorker length outside off stump, McBrine attempts to drive it to the off-side but misses it.
This time bowls outside off stump which McBrine pushes it to cover.
Good length delivery on middle stump, McBrine blocks it out.
Short delivery on leg stump, O'Brien flicks it away towards square leg for a single.

Overthrow! Needless from Curran. It also gets Kevin on strike. This is fuller and on off, it is played back to the bowler who throws it wildly at his opposite end. Bairstow runs to his right, dives but fails to stop it. A single taken.
Woakes again drifts onto the pads. McBrine plays it towards the deep square leg fielder softly and takes a single.
Woakes bowls this one on the pads of O'Brien, he flicks it towards deep square leg for a couple.
The batsman has attempted to put bat on ball - but fails
Bouncer! Woakes goes for the bouncer this time. It is on middle and off but Kevin ducks and does well to evade it.
Woakes bowls this one similarly to the last one. O'Brien is struck on the pads again, but this time there is nothing to worry about.

Huge appeal by the English team! Seems to be hitting the pads of Kevin. The ball was bowled on middle and angling down the leg side. O'Brien tries to flick the ball but misses. The England players think that O'Brien has edged it but the umpire does not agree.
Looks to get this one back in, it is down the leg side though. The batsman lets it be.
On a length this time and shaping away. McBrine looks to defend but it goes off the outer half to point.
This time a yorker length on middle stump, McBrine plays it well and flicks it towards the leg side for a dot ball.
Another miss! Excellent stuff. Bowled at a good length and outside off. McBrine fends for it but ends up missing it. Good pressure created by Curran.
Good bowling from Curran, it was a good length delivery outside off stump which McBrine tries to defend but misses it altogether.
Andy McBrine is the new man in.

OUT! Drags it on! Another one in the innings! A poor shot to be honest by Adair! Yes, this is short but not very short. Also, it is angling away from off. Adair looks to drag the pull through mid-wicket but the ball hits the inside edge and disturbs the stumps behind. From 132 for 2, Ireland are 149 for 7. England into the lower order now.
Drinks Break!
On the pads, Adair flicks it to the on side and gets a single.
Yorker on middle and off, Adair does well to get his bat down in time.
Length ball on off, O'Brien runs it down to third man and gets to the other end.
Back of a length ball on off, O'Brien tries to defend but ends up getting an inside edge onto his pads.
Good length ball pitching on middle and leg. It comes back in after pitching. O'Brien looks to defend but misses and it hits him high on his thigh pad.
On middle and leg, Kevin tucks it to mid-wicket.
Chris Woakes is back into the attack!
Fuller on the stumps, Adair taps it back to the bowler.
Around off, O'Brien guides it down towards third man for a single.
Good length ball on off, Kevin looks to defend but once again gets an inside edge onto his pads.

Back of a length ball on off, Kevin looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pads. The ball rolls onto the side of the pitch on the off side. Adair comes out looking for a non-existent single. O'Brien rightfully sends him back. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
Outside off, Kevin leaves it alone.
Good length ball on off, O'Brien punches it to mid off.
Sam Curran is back into the attack. He was the most impressive bowler in his first spell.
Good length ball on off, O'Brien looks to drive but gets a thick outside edge which goes down the leg side. Single taken.
Good length ball on off, O'Brien defends it off the front foot.
Short ball but down the leg side. O'Brien ducks under it.
On the leg side, Kevin looks to flick but misses.
Close! O'Brien had no idea where this one went. Good length ball around off, Kevin looks to slap it but gets a thick outside edge and the ball goes towards the third man region. They take a couple.
Full on off, O'Brien taps it back to the bowler.
Broad bowls this one on middle and off. Adair gets right in the line of the delivery and pushes it back.
Broad bowls it on the hips of Adair, he pulls it towards the deep mid-wicket region. The batters take a couple of runs.
On off, Adair defends it off the front foot.

BEATEN! Beauty by Broad! This time he bowls it on a length and on the fourth stump line. It pitches and moves away sharply from Adair. Mark tries to play at it off the back foot but is completely beaten.
Fuller this time on off by Broad trying to bring out the drive from Adair. Adair is not interested and defends it.
Mark Adair is the new man in.

OUT! Another beauty from Broad! Ireland are losing the plot here in the final session of the day. Broad bowls it full around off, Thompson shoulders arms to it expecting it to go away after pitching. The ball though comes in with the angle and goes onto disturb the off pole. Thompson would be disappointed looking at that and he will be reminded about this wicket for sometime now.
Fuller on off, Kevin blocks it out to see off the over.
Good length ball on off, Kevin defends it off the front foot.
OH! Stone is enjoying bowling in this final session. He bowls this full outside off, O'Brien goes for a drive but the ball moves away and misses his outside edge by just a whisker.
Down the leg side this time. Kevin lets it go to the keeper.
Back of a length ball on off, O'Brien defends it off his back foot.
Full on off and middle, Kevin flicks it towards mid-wicket and gets a couple.
Beautiful this. Length delivery around off, it comes back in to the southpaw after pitching. Thompson looks to defend but the ball cuts him in half.
Closer to the off pole this time and Thompson defends it off the front foot.
Comes 'round the wicket and bowls it outside off, Thompson leaves it alone.
On the pads, O'Brien turns it square down the leg side and gets a single.
Full on off, O'Brien defends it off the front foot.
Fuller on off, Kevin strokes it to cover.

Good ball to finish off the over. It is pitched on a good length but just outside leg. Thompson tries to flick it but misses and the ball hits his pads. England appeal half heartedly but the umpire turns it down. A successful over by Stone comes to an end.
Stuart Thompson is the new man in.

OUT! Caught! Gary goes for a duck. After peppering him with a few short balls, Stone hits the deck hard on this one on off, Wilson goes chasing after it but ends up getting a thick outside edge, It goes straight to Joe Root at first slip who takes an easy catch. Root has not had the best of days at slip but this catch should give him confidence.
Down the leg side, Wilson looks to flick but misses.
Edged but did not carry! Ireland living dangerously here. Stone bowls it on a good length on the fifth stump line, it just swings away and takes the outside edge of Wilson's bat.

Brilliant bouncer to follow up the wicket! Welcome to the crease Gary Wilson! It is a perfect bouncer, right at neck height and on the middle pole. Wilson does really well to keep it down as he gets on top of the delivery and pushes it into the ground.
Next man in for Ireland is Gary Wilson.

OUT! Bowled! First wicket for Stone in Test cricket and what a beauty it is! Full and pacy, it pitches on middle and leg. Balbirnie expects it to come in but the ball moves away just a bit after pitching. Balbirnie plays all over it and it goes onto hit the middle stump. That ball is every fast bowler's dream ball.
Good length ball on off, O'Brien defends it off the front foot.
FOUR! Glorious, absolutely glorious! Broad overpitches just a fraction. O'Brien pounces on it and slams his drive through covers for a boundary.
On the stumps, Kevin defends it with authority off his front foot.
Back of a length ball on off, O'Brien defends it off the back foot.
Once again outside off, O'Brien lets it carry to the keeper.
Outside off on a length, O'Brien shoulders arms to it.
Again bowls it outside the off pole and AB shoulders arms to it.
Outside off, Balbirnie leaves it alone.

Sneaky single by the batters. This is bowled on a good length just outside off. Kevin dabs it towards point with soft hands and takes off for a quick single. He completes it with ease. Good running here by the Irishmen.
Olly goes for another bouncer but this time a much better one. It is right on the batters head height but he ducks under it.
Better bowling this time by Stone. Bowls it on the middle pole. O'Brien taps it onto the ground and keeps it out.
Short ball but not well directed by Olly. It goes way down the leg side and Bairstow collects it.
Once again on the fourth stump line, Balbirnie does not disturb that one.
Outside off on a length, Balbirnie shoulders arms to it.
Kevin is off the mark straightaway. Good length ball on the pads, O'Brien turns it towards mid-wicket and gets a single.
Kevin O'Brien is the new man in.

OUT! High but not high enough to change the umpire's call. The ball is going to clip the top of leg. Good length ball pitching on off, it comes back in sharply. Stirling looks to defend but gets beaten by the inward movement. The ball hits him flush on the front pads. Broad starts celebrating and then turns back to see the umpire's reaction. Aleem Dar agrees with Broad and raises his finger. Stirling has a chat with his partner and then takes it upstairs. Replays roll in and Hawk Eye shows the ball was going onto clip the top of leg pole. End of a good knock from Stirling.
Stirling has been given out LBW. He has reviewed. Is it too high? Could turn out to be a good review.
On middle and leg, Stirling tucks it towards mid-wicket.
Good length ball outside off, Stirling looks to play that one but misses.
Stuart Broad is back on for another burst.
Good length ball wide outiside off, Balbirnie has a poke at it but misses.

FOUR! Edgy but will do for Ireland. This ball is fullish and on off, Stirling drives at it and tries to play it towards covers. He gets a thick outside edge but luckily for him, the ball goes towards the empty third man region and the ball has enough pace on to race away for a boundary.
Bouncer on the leg pole line by Stone. Balbirnie ducks under it and lets it through to Bairstow.
This time on the pads of Stirling, he flicks it towards deep square leg for a single.
Similar delivery, pitching on the fifth stump line and on a length, the ball swings away. It is left alone by the batter.
Good start by Stone. Length ball outside off, Stirling lets it through to the keeper.
The players are back on for the final session of the day. Olly Stone will start the final session of the day. Andy Balbirnie and Paul Stirling to continue their innings.
... Day 1, Session 3 ...

The lead is now nearing 50 and Ireland would hope they can add as many as possible. The two out there are going really well and Ireland would want them to continue. For England, it is the same, they need wickets or they will be facing a stiff task going ahead in the game. Join us for what will be the last session of Day 1 in a bit.

Ireland continue dominating the game! Their batters have done excellently till now. However, the English bowlers haven't bowled at their best too. They were very wayward with the new ball which made it easy for the Ireland openers to get through that phase. Sam Curran then came on and did provide two quick wickets but Balbirne and Stirling have got things back on track with a 50-plus run stand.
Tossed up on the stumps, Balbirnie defends it off the front foot. That will be the last ball of this session. That is Tea on day 1.
Tossed up on middle, Balbirnie glances it to mid-wicket.
Floated on the stumps, AB defends it off the front foot.
Floated on the stumps, Balbirnie defends it off the front foot.
Short around off, Stirling guides it down the vacant third man region and gets 3 runs.
On the pads, Balbirnie flicks it to the leg side for one.

FIFTY! Second half-century in Test matches for Balbirnie. It was a full delivery from Woakes. Balbirnie gets an inside edge towards mid-wicket and take off for a single. It has been a brilliant innings from Balbirnie and will look to continue to on for his team.
Full on off, Andy defends it towards mid on.

FOUR! Brilliant shot from Balbirnie. Another full delivery from Woakes and Balbirnie is in such good form that he will not miss. It was bowled on leg-stump and Andy flicks it towards mid-wicket for a boundary.
Short on middle stump, Balbirnie rocks back and defends it towards the off-side for a dot ball.
Good length ball outside off, Balbirnie leaves it alone.

FOUR! Width from Woakes and Balbirnie latches onto it and hits it past the point fielder for his ninth boundary. It was full and outside off stump. Balbirnie will not miss out on these easy deliveries.

Floated on off, Balbirnie looks to defend with soft hands but gets a thick outside edge. Luckily it falls short and wide of the diving first slip fielder. The ball goes towards the third man region and the batsmen comeback for the third.
Tossed up on middle, Balbirnie strokes it to mid on.
Flighted on off, Balbirnie defends it off the front foot.
On the pads, Balbirnie turns it to square leg.
Tossed up on middle, AB taps it back to the bowler.
Off spinner on middle and off, Balbirnie tucks it to mid-wicket with the spin.
Short delivery on middle stump, Stirling blocks it out.
Full delivery and on middle stump. Balbirnie drives it hard down the ground but finds the mid on fielder. A single taken.
Good length delivery on middle stump, Balbirnie stands back and blocks it out.
Full on off, Balbirnie drives it through covers and gets a couple as the fielder mops it up before the ropes.
Fuller delivery from Woakes on the middle stump, Stirling trying to drive it straight gets an inside edge towards leg side. The batsmen take a single.
Starts his new spell with a full ball on off, Stirling defends it off the front foot.
Chris Woakes is back on. He was wicketless in his first spell.
Shorter on off, Stirling punches it to coves for a single.
Floated on off, PS drives it through covers for a couple.
Flighted on the stumps, Stirling defends it off the front foot.
Flighted on off, Balbirnie drives it nicely through covers, The ball though does not have the legs to go to the fence. 3 runs taken.
Floated on off, Stirling looks to sweep but gets an inside edge which goes down the leg side. They take a single.
Starts with a very full ball outside off Stirling looks to sweep but misses and the ball hits him on his front pad.
Moeen Ali into the attack now.
FOUR! Brilliantly played! Short around off, Balbirnie waits and punches it late through point for a boundary. It also brings up the 100 for Ireland.
Loopy delivery on middle stump, Balbirnie defends it back to the bowler.
Another flat delivery, Stirling drives it to cover for another single.
Flatter delivery on off stump, Balbirnie pushes it to cover for a single.
FOUR! Brilliant execution! Another tossed up ball on off, Balbirnie stretches forward and paddles it fine down the leg side for a boundary.
Flighted delivery whichn ended up as a full toss. Stirling flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single. There was an appeal for LBW but the ball did not come off the pad.
Outside off, AB follows the boundary with a calm leave.

FOUR! Classy! Fuller and way outside off by Broad, unusual by him in this innings. Balbirnie takes full advantage of it as he swings his arms at it and carves the ball through the point region for a boundary.
Similar line and length by Broad, Balbirnie leaves it alone.
Good bowling by Broad keeping it on the fourth and fifth stump line. Andy knows exactly where his stumps are and shoulders arms to it.
Straighter in line this time on middle, Andy plays it back to Broad.
Bowled on a length outside off, Balbirnie lets it through to Bairstow.
Shorter on off, Stirling looks to cut but it goes off the outside edge of his bat. The ball goes wide of slip and they take two. Ireland equal England's first innings score here.
Another loopy delivery from Leach, Paul blocks it again for another dot ball.
Once again floated on off, Paul drives it but finds cover.
Full delivery on off stump, Stirling comes forward and blocks it to the cover fielder.

FOUR! Signs of aggression here from Stirling! Tossed up on middle, Stirling comes down the track and hits it with power to the left of mid on. The man there dives but to no avail. The ball beats him and goes to the fence for a boundary.
Loopy delivery on middle stump, Stirling defends it to the cover fielder.

FOUR! Graceful! Driven with absolute class by Balbirnie! Broad misses his mark as he bowls this one fuller and outside off. Balbirnie gets into the perfect position to play the cover drive and times the shot to perfection. He looks in great touch here. England have to do sometyhing quickly here to stay in the game.
Good length ball on middle and leg, Stirling tucks it towards mid-wicket and rotates the strike.
On the body, AB glances it to the on side and gets to the other end.
Good length ball outside off, Balbirnie looks to defend but gets beaten.
On the pads, Stirling flicks it to the on side for a single.

DROPPED! England cannot afford to miss these chances. Broad bowls another superb delivery pitching on a length on the fourth stump line. It nips away from Stirling after pitching, he gets an outside edge and it goes to skipper Joe Root at first slip. He gets down on one knee but misses a dolly as the ball slips through between his hands. Stirling survives and he is given a lifeline here by Root.
Fumble at covers lets Stirling take one.
Fuller delivery on off stump, Stirling pushes it to the cover fielder for a dot ball.
Floated on middle and off, Stirling defends it off the front foot.
Another loopy delivery and another sweep from Stirling towards the same area. The batsmen cross over for a double.
FOUR! Smart batting this. Leach tosses it up, Stirling stretches ahead and takes it on the full. He sweeps this hard through square leg for a boundary.
Loopy delivery on off-stump, Stirling gets on his knees and converts it to a full toss sweeping it towards fine leg for a double.
Jack Leach to bowl after the break.

Drinks Break! England have improved their bowling from the last drinks break but they have just got two wickets. Ireland trail by just 22 runs and with 8 wickets in hand one would hope they will take a big lead from here on.
Good length ball outside off, Balbirnie lets it carry to the keeper. Good signs by Broad here.

EDGED AND FOUR! Right between first slip and the keeper. Good length ball pitching on off. The ball moves away just a bit after pitching. The minimal movement on that is enough to trouble the batsman. Balbirnie looks to defend but gets a thick outside edge. Bairstow does not go for the catch and Root at first slip is late to react. The ball goes between the two to the third man fence for a boundary. Broad deserved a wicket with that ball.
Full on off, Balbirnie defends it off the front foot.
Fuller on middle this time, Andy plays it towards the mid on fielder.
Length ball on the body, Balbirnie plays it to mid on.

Peach of a delivery this by Broad! Length ball right on the fourth stump line, Broad induces the shot from Andy. He goes for the pushes but before he realises the ball is past his bat. Luckily for him he didn't get any bat on it.

FOUR! Beautifully hit from Stirling. Curran should not be bowling so short especially at this pace. Stirling rocks back and pulls it hard to the deep mid-wicket fence and gets his first boundary of the innings. Good over for the Irish.
Good length ball on middle stump, Stirling blocks it towards the off-side.
On a shorter length outside off stump, Stirling gets an inside edge back to the bowler. No run.
Good length delivery on off stump, Stirling pushes it to the cover fielder for a dot ball.
Short ball on off, Balbirnie pulls it away towards fine leg for one.
FOUR! Good shot from Balbirnie. Full delivery from Curran outside off-stump, Balbirnie creams it through cover for his second boundary.

Edged but short! Bowled a hint outside off, the ball shapes away from Stirling. He tries to forcefully push at it but only manages to get the outside edge. Luckily for him it fell short of the fielder at 2nd slip.
Stirling drives this full one to the mid off fielder.
Stirling pushes this right back towards the bowler as he gets right behind the line of the delivery.
Short of a length ball, Stirling guides it to point.
Broad bowls this on middle and leg. It hits on the pads as the batsman tries to flick but misses.

FOUR! 50 up for the Irish with this boundary. Broad bowls it on a good length and just outside off. This gives Stirling enough space to open his arms a bit and guide the ball single-handedly towards the gap at third-man. Boundary signalled by the umpire.
Short delivery on middle stump, Balbirnie tries to flick it but misses it and gets hit on the pads. Another good over from Curran.

leg-bye! Excellent inswinging yorker from Curran. He is bowling really well today. It angled down leg side and hits it on the pads of Stirling. The ball goes towards the leg side and the batsmen cross over for a single.
Paul Stirling is the new man in.

OUT! Plays it on! Sam Curran gets another one. Excellent bowling from him. He comes around the wicket and lands this around off, it is angling into McCollum. He looks to drive it against the angle and that proves to be his downfall. He ends up getting an inside edge which shatters the stumps behind. Ireland still 41 runs behind.
Good length delivery on leg stump, James flicks it towards the mid-wicket fielder. No run.
Fuller delivery from Curran, McCollum pushes it towards the mid off fielder.
Short delivery on middle stump, James blocks it out to the off side.
On the pads of Balbirnie this time by Broad, the batter flicks it to mid-wicket. A maiden for Broad but even he knows that's not enough. They need wickets and quickly.
Back of a length on the fifth stump line. Andy plays it to the point fielder off the front foot.
Andy pushes it back to the bowler.
Similar ball again by Broad. On a good length outside off, Balbirnie shoulders arms.
Bowls this one outside off on a good length. The batter lets it go through to the keeper.
Broad starts off with a good length ball on middle. Andy pushes it to the mid-wicket fielder.
Stuart Broad is back!
Full delivery outside off stump, McCollum tries to drive it hard through the off side but can get an inside edge which goes towards the cover fielder.
FOUR! Poor delivery from Curran. It was a full delivery on the pads. All McCollum had to do was help it on its way to the fine leg boundary and he does it gleefully.
Fuller this time from Curran on middle stump, McCollum drives it straight down the ground for a double.
Good length delivery on off stump, McCollum pushes it to cover for a dot ball.
Good short ball from Curran, McCollum ducks under it and lets it go to the keeper.
Short delivery on the leg stump, Balbirnie flicks  it to mid on and take a single.
Good length ball on middle, the batter pushes it back to the bowler.
On a good length on the fourth stump line, McCOllum pushes it to the cover fielder.
Outside off, McCollum looks to go after it but misses. Loose shot that.
On the stumps, this is blocked.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Down the leg side, McCollum looks to flick but misses.
Full delivery on the off stump, McCollum pushes it to mid off.
Goes fuller again but this is on middle, Balbirnie hits it to mid on.
FOUR! Balbirnie is off the mark with a brilliant shot. It was fuller this time from Curran but Andy is ready for it and strokes it through the cover fielder for his first boundary.
Good probing length bowling from Curran. It hits the inside edge of Balbirnie's bat towards the leg side. No run.
Another good length delivery, Balbirnie defends it the off side.
Good length delivery on leg stump, Balbirnie tries to flick it towards fine leg but Bairstow makes a brilliant stop behind the stumps.
JAFFA! That missed the off pole by just. This is bowled behind a length outside off, it jags back in sharply. Beats the inside edge of Balbirnie's bat and goes over the off pole.
Balbirnie drives this full ball towards mid-on. The fielder divea and saves a run for his side.
Stone bowls this one a bit short but Balbirnie defends it off the back foot to the cover fielder.

Ooh! Close one! Curran bowls this one on the pads of McCollum, he tries to play it towards mid-wicket but fails to close the bat in time. McCollum gets the inside edge of the bat as it uppishly goes past the fielder at short-leg. The fielder dives to his right but is unable to get a hand to it. The batters are able to steal a single.
Right on middle and on a good length, the batter pushes it into the ground and towards short-leg.
Down the leg side, McCollum tries to flick but misses.
Short delivery on the pads, Andy flicks it to the leg side but a run is not available.
Another good length delivery on off stump, Balbirnie drives it towards the cover fielder but there is no run available.
Good length delivery on off stump, Andy pushes it towards the point fielder for another dot ball.
Another short one from Curran, Balbirnie defends it towards mid off.
Short delivery on off stump, Balbirnie defends it off the back foot towards the leg side.
Andy Balbirnie replaces his skipper out in the middle.

OUT! Curran comes on and he strikes straightaway. A soft, soft dismissal and a much-needed wicket for England. It is a short ball but skids through off the wicket. Porterfield looks to pull but the ball hits the higher portion of the bat and lobs towards the man in front of square. Leach makes no mistake. Porterfield walks back disappointed and rightly so. It was not a great delivery. He was looking really good until then. Ireland trail by another 53 runs.
Sam Curran is on now!
On the stumps again, blocked again by McCollum.
Stone pulls this one back of a length in the line of middle and off. McCollum gets right behind the line of the delivery and defends it off the back foot.

Beautiful shot and great fielding! Good cricket all around. Stone bowls this one full and outside off, Porterfield gets on the front foot and leans into the cover drive. Jack Leach gives the chase and pulls the ball into the field to save a run for his side.

The physio is out in the middle! Seeing that, the umpires have called for DRINKS! It has been all Ireland today, after bowling England out, their batters have started off nicely. The two need to continue though. England on the other hand, have been poor with the ball. They haven't made the batters play a lot. They need to break this stand somehow and then hope for a couple quickly. Will the Irish continue domination or will England fight back?
Nasty! Hits the helmet of Porterfield. Stone bowls a pacy bouncer on the leg and middle pole line. Porterfield tries to duck but cannot get out of the way in time.
Full just outside off this time, pushed to point by Porterfield.
Yorker length ball to start the over off. Porterfield jams it out to the mid off fielder.
Good shot from McCollum. It was bowled on a good length outside off stump. James drives hard but again finds the fielder at cover.
Good length delivery outside off, McCollum lets it go back to the keeper.
Fuller delivery on off stump, James drives but straight to the cover fielder.
Good length delivery on off stump, McCollum faces no difficulty in defending it to the off side.
Short delivery, McCollum defends it off the back foot to the off-side.
Excellent delivery from Broad. Short delivery on off stump, McCollum plays and misses.
Down the leg side, Porterfield looks to flick but misses.
On the pads, Porterfield looks to flick but the ball goes to the keeper off his thigh pad.

FOUR! This is not a bad ball at all. Slightly fuller on the pads, it moves away a bit after pitching. Porterfield looks to flick but closes the face of the bat early. The ball takes a leading edge and goes through point for a boundary.
Good length ball pitching on off, it goes away with the angle. WP looks to defend it inside the line but misses.
Once again bowls it full around off, Porterfield defends it to mid on.
Starts with a full ball on off, McCollum pushes it through covers. The fielder gives it a chase and pulls it before the ropes. 3 runs taken.
Olly Stone to bowl his first over for England in Test cricket.
Broad finishes the over off with a dot. It is bowled on a length on the fifth stump line, WP lets it go.
On a length outside off, Porterfield leaves it alone.
Length ball on the body of Porterfield, he defends it off the back foot.
This time the ball angles into Porterfield. It is pitched on a good length and nips back in. It takes the inside half of the bat and rolls towards the fine leg fielder as the batters take a couple.
Good bowling by Broad, trying to induce the drive from the batsman. He bowls it on a good length just outside off, the ball nips away. Porterfield is smart enough and lets it go.
On a length outside off by Broad, WP shoulders arms to this one.
Another back of a length delivery, McCollum defends it to the off side.
Short outside off stump, James leaves it alone.

FOUR! Good shot from McCollum. Woakes keeps on bowling short but this time bowls it on the legs. McCollum plays a glance towards square leg where the fine leg fielder runs and makes a valiant effort to stop the boundary but in vain.
Another short one on middle stump, James plays it back to the bowler.
Back of a length delivery on off stump, McCollum gets an while trying to defend it. The ball bounces just ahead of first slip.
Short ball on off stump, McCollum defends it to the off side.
Attacks the off pole but Porterfield is solid in defense. Another maiden for Braod.
Shouts of catch it but there is no bat involved! Fuller and outside off, swinging away further. Porterfield looks to drive but misses.
Ouch! Shorter and angling into the body, Porterfield looks to pull but misses to get hit near the stomach.
On the fuller side, Porterfield pushes it to the man at mid on.
Once again, an easy leave as Broad bowls another one outside off.
Outside off, the batter lets it be. England are not making the batters play enough here.

Two byes! Woah! What happened there. The ball was pitched full and wide outside off. After pitching the ball swings a long way away from McCollum. Bairstow dives to his right in order to save it but he is only able to get a hand to it. The ball rolls towards the third man region and the batters take a couple of runs.
Length delivery by Woakes just outside off, McCollum guides it to the man at point.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Woakes bowls it on the pads, McCollum flicks it but straight to the fielder.
McCollum has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

Peach of a delivery by Woakes! The ball lands in the perfect area, on a length and on the off pole. It nips just away from the batter after pitching. He plays inside the line and misses the ball. Good bowling here by Woakes.

FOUR BYES! A poor end to the over. This is way down the leg side, keeps going away further with the angle. Porterfield leaves it. Bairstow dives full stretch to his right but has no chance. It goes to the fine leg fence.
Slightly fuller this time and outside off, the batter lets it be.
Almost an action reply of the last ball. This is once again angled into the off pole. It pitches and leaves the batter. Porterfield looks to defend but is beaten again.
Beauty! From around the wicket, Broad angles this into the off pole, it pitches and then straightens. Whizzes past the outside edge as Porterfield looks to defend.
Another length delivery outside off, the batter does not play at it.
On the fuller side and outside off, the batter does not bother playing at it.
Woakes hits the deck hard and bowls it just a bit outside off. McCollum defends it off the back foot.
Shortish ball this time just outside off on the fourth stump line. Porterfield pushes it towards the cover region with soft hands and quickly takes a single. Good running by the Irish.
On a length just outside, WP shoulders arms to this one.
Down the leg side. Porterfield tries to flick but misses.
Back of a length by Woakes this time, Pushed back to the bowler off the back foot.
FOUR! Elegant! Woakes bowls this one full and just outside off. Porterfield just leans into the shot and drives it towards the gap through the mid off region as the ball slowly rolls to the fence.
Attacks the off pole but McCollum is solid in defense.
Goes back to bowling length and outside off, it is left alone.
FOUR! McCollum is off the mark in style! This time he connects with the drive. This is very full on off, McCollum just puts bat on ball and hits it through covers for a boundary.
Goes wide of the crease and angles this into the stumps, McCollum stays back and keeps it out.
BEATEN! On the fuller side but just behind a driving length. Gets this one to straighten. The batter looks to drive it through the off side but misses.
A huge appeal but this is going down leg. On the pads, Porterfield looks to flick but misses. The ball hits the pads and rolls on the leg side. A leg bye is taken.
The ball is bowled down the leg side again by Woakes. McCollum tries to flick it towards the fine leg but misses. End of the over and it is a maiden to start with by Woakes.
Wider outside off this time by Woakes. McCollum leaves it alone.
Better line in this delivery. Between the fourth and fifth stump line on the off side, it is a good length delivery. McCollum knows exactly where his stumps are and lets it go to the keeper.
Down the leg side this time. McCollum tries flicking it but does not connect. The ball carries to Bairstow.
Similar length but wider this time. McCollum leaves it again as it carries low to the keeper.
First ball by Woakes. Back of a length just outside off, McCollum shoulders arms to this one.
Chris Woakes to bowl from the other end. He can be really good on this wicket.
A maiden to begin with by Broad! The last ball is outside off, William lets it be.
Well played in the end! This is fuller and it is angling into the batter. Porterfield initially looks to flick but seeing the ball move away, keeps it out with a straight bat.
Wider outside off this time and Porterfield makes one more leave.
Drags his length back this time and also bowls this one outside off, Porterfield lets it be.
Another one a little too straight, looking to hit the pad of WP. He gets his bat down though and plays it to mid on.
Broad starts off with a fuller ball angling into the pads from around the wicket. Porterfield works it to square leg.
